dedupe_keys.name: non destructive detection of local aging in lithium ion pouch cells by multi directional laser scanning

description: The experiment uses three-dimensional laser scanning to investigate reversible and irreversible local thickness changes in six commercial LiCoO2/graphite pouch cells during cyclic aging. Two cells were exposed to each of three temperature and charging-rate scenarios. The native description relates irreversible thickness change to capacity fade and resistance increase measured by electrochemical impedance spectroscopy.
